The Event Order API (POS) works by allowing customers to send order messages and receive optimized transport management system (TMS) routes. The process begins when a customer places an order, and the API is triggered once the order has stock allocation and is confirmed, typically 1 to 4 days before the collection date. The API supports four main message types: NEW (for orders with stock allocated), UPDATE (for amendments), CANCEL (for cancellations), and COMPLETE (once despatched). 

After the order is sent through the Event Order API, the Event TMS plans and optimizes the order, allocating it to the best carrier and rate. Then, the Event Go API triggers the planned routes back to the customer. The preferred logistics provider starts the delivery, and Event Go can trigger tracking updates. When delivery is confirmed, Event Go sends delivery confirmation with proof of delivery (POD). Any additional approved cost additions can also be triggered by Event Go. 

The API endpoints are environment-specific: for UAT, use POST /Oasis/omf, and for PROD, use POST /Oasis/omf. The integration flow expects orders to generally be received the day before collection is due for optimization, carrier allocation, and notification. The system is designed to keep the TMS updated with the most current order book, following the ebb and flow of sales in real time.
